witness.title: Game log witness
witness.not_configured: Game log witness unavailable: select a game channel directory.
witness.explanation: Optional, local and read-only. Only validated terminal, buy-side assortment, container-size and major/minor version facts are inspected. No prices, quantities or status values are read into reports. Game.log is never included in diagnostics.
update.title: Release updates
update.explanation: Optional daily checks for standard Tallyline releases on GitHub. Only the app name and version are sent. Open release notes to choose whether to download an update yourself.
update.available: A new Tallyline release is available:
update.current: No newer standard release is available.
update.not_checked: No release update information is available yet.
update.unavailable: Release updates are unavailable. Work can continue. Checks will resume after the daily interval; Settings can turn them off.
update.dismissed: The available release notice was dismissed.
